synth.notes:
Mirror-axis single-axis game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (axis 10, piece 5, target 11, reflection 4, bg 9).
A1/A2 move the selection a block row (axis unblocked; pieces blocked by edge/other pieces), A3/A4 move a selected piece by a column (no-op on axis).
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; selected piece grown from 0-centre blocks through non-9 centres to split merged pieces.
Reflections at row 2A-r skip piece-occupied blocks; render stack piece>refl>target>axis, centre = first solid else first fill else 9.
HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective action (5s overwrite past 64, unobserved here); stateless, 29/29.
